Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TROLLEY, DRESSING DRUM 



1. Scope — Dimensions and offier requirements for dressing-drum trolley used in hospitals. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shiown in Fig. 1. 

3. Materials 

3.1 framew^orA — Electric resistance butt-welded steel tube (ERW) conforming to 15:2039-1964 
* Specification for steel tubes for bicycle and allied purposes '. 

3.2 Rings — Mild steel wire conforming to IS : 280-1962 ' Specification for mild steel wire for general 
engineering purposes ( revised) \ 

3.3 Pedals, Foot Operated Lever Mechanisms and Drum Supports — Steel flats conforming to 
15:4030-1973 'Specification for cold rolled carbon steel strip for general engineering purposes 
(first revision ) ' or IS : 1029-1970 * Specification for hot rolled steel strips ( baling ) ( first revision ) \ 

4. Manufacture and Workmanship 

4.1 The components shall be assembled by welding in accordance with the relevant requirements 
of IS : 816-1969 * Code of practice for use of metal arc welding for general construction in mild steel 
(first revision) \ IS : 819-1957 * Code of practice for resistance spot welding for light assemblies in 
mild steel ', and IS : 1323-1966 * Code of practice for oxy-acetylene welding for structural work in 
mild steel (revised) \ 

4.1.1 The welding shall fully penetrate and shall be sound in every detjail. The welds shall be 
finished flush. In the finished stage, there shall be no exposed sharp edges or other unsealed 
formations which may harbour dirt or other foreign matter. 

4.2 The trolley shall be capable of accommodating three sizes of dressing drums. 

4.3 The trolley shall be provided with foot operated lever mechanisms capable of effecting Instant 
opening and closing of the lids, there being a separate lever mechanism for each lid. 

4.4 The ends of the pedals may be provided with caps made of plastics, rubber or other resilient 
material, 

4.5 The trolley shall be fitted with castors conforming to Designation HN 50 x 20 x 6 PG of 
IS : 4034-1968 ' Specification for castors for hospital equipment '. 

4.6 The trolley shall be free from dents, burrs and sharp edges. 

4.7 The trolley shall also satisfy the requirements given in 4 of IS : 4033-1968 ' General requirements 
for hospital furniture '. 

5. Finish — The trolley shall be painted in accordance with 5.1 of IS : 4033-1968. The enamels for 
the undercoat and finishing coat shall conform to IS : 2932-1964 'Specification for enamel, synthetic, 
exterior. Type 1, ( a ) undercoating, ( b ) finishing, colour as required '. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Adhesion Test - As prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-1968, 

6.2 Performance T est — T\\B trolley with all the dressing drums loaded shall be pushed on a level 
surface. It shall not wobble or rattle. It shall also move freely when pulled in circular motion and 
the castors shall face in the same direction without much effort. 

7. Marking — The trolley shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark, or shall have a label fixed to it bearing this information. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking —-Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing— As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
